entities.name: Kadiatou Touré
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kadiatou Touré is a Malian women's basketball player. Toure competed for Mali at the 2008 Summer Olympics, where she scored 17 points in 5 games. She was born in Markala, Ségou Region on the Niger River.
